SELECT m.user_id, m.display_name, m.joined_at FROM enterprise_member m JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND m.user_id <> #{departing} AND m.status = 'active' AND u.status = 'active' AND LOCATE(#{query}, m.display_name) > 0
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.enterprise_id = ur.enterprise_id AND r.id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND rp.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.enterprise_id = m.enterprise_id AND ur.user_id = m.user_id AND r.status = 'active' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND rp.permission_code = #{permission})
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM todo_item pending WHERE pending.enterprise_id = m.enterprise_id AND pending.owner_user_id = #{departing} AND pending.deleted_at IS NULL AND pending.status IN ('pending', 'in_progress') AND pending.team_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enterprise_team_member tm JOIN enterprise_team t ON t.enterprise_id = tm.enterprise_id AND t.id = tm.team_id WHERE tm.enterprise_id = pending.enterprise_id AND tm.team_id = pending.team_id AND tm.user_id = m.user_id AND t.status = 'active' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL))
AND (m.joined_at < #{after.time} OR (m.joined_at = #{after.time} AND m.user_id < #{after.id}))
ORDER BY m.joined_at DESC, m.user_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
